newsitem.title: MONACO: ATHLETICS-BEVILACQUA DECISION PUT BACK FOR A DAY.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BEVILACQUA DECISION PUT BACK FOR A DAY.

text.p: The International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) has postponed until Tuesday a decision by an arbitration panel in the drugs case of Italian high jumper Antonella Bevilacqua.
IAAF spokesman Giorgio Reineri said on Monday that the arbitration panel, which had been expected to announce its decision on Monday evening, needed more time.
"The panel heard the lawyers for both sides and Antonella Bevilacqua was here too but they said they needed more time for this case," Reineri said in a telephone interview.
Bevilacqua tested positive twice in May for the stimulant ephedrine but an Italian panel ruled she had taken the drug by accident and did not impose the statutory three-month ban.
Bevilacqua was allowed to compete at the Atlanta Olympics after the IAAF's legal advisors said the federation could be sued in a civil court but she finished outside the medals.
